title: Nanoscale Au–Si eutectic mixtures formed by dewetting of a Au–Ni film on Si3N4
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41917-41923
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04389A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yoonhee Kim, Kang Woo Ahn, Su Yong Lee, Jin Woo Kim, Hyon Chol Kang, Chan Kim, Do Young Noh
Formation of a eutectic AuSi compound was observed during the solid state dewetting and agglomeration in a Ni–Au bilayer thin film grown on a Si3N4 substrate using coherent X-ray diffractive imaging, X-ray diffraction, and SEM.
